```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(skimr)
source(here("R", "prepare_data.R"))
source(here("R", "steps.R"))
source(here("R", "plots.R"))
theme_set(theme_bw())
tidymodels_prefer()
```

References:
- [`recipes` R package (Tidymodels)](https://www.tidymodels.org/start/recipes/)

```{r}
SPECTRA_DIR = here("data/RT_spectra")
SOIL_PROP_FILE = here("data/RT_wetchem_soildata.csv")
```

```{r}
TARGET <- "clay_perc"

# --- Preprocessing ----------------------------------------------------------
RESAMPLE_BY <- 5L
RESAMPLING_GRID <- seq(3995, 600, by = -5)
SG_W        <- 15L   # tuned in tune_sg.qmd
SG_P        <- 3L    # tuned in tune_sg.qmd
SG_M        <- 1L    # first derivative — confirmed in tune_sg.qmd
```


## Getting data

```{r}
data <- prepare_rt(SPECTRA_DIR, SOIL_PROP_FILE)
```

## Recipes

### Defining roles

```{r}
spc_cols <- names(data)[startsWith(names(data), "wn_")]
meta_cols <- setdiff(names(data), c(TARGET, spc_cols))

rec <- recipe(data) |>
  update_role(all_of(TARGET),  new_role = "outcome") |>
  update_role(all_of(spc_cols), new_role = "predictor") |>
  update_role(all_of(meta_cols), new_role = "metadata")
```

```{r}
summary(rec)
```

### Resampling

```{r}
rec_res <- rec |>
  step_log(all_outcomes(), base = 10) |>
  step_resample(grid = RESAMPLING_GRID)
```


```{r}
rec_prep <- prep(rec_res, training = data, verbose = TRUE)

data_processed <- bake(
  rec_prep,
  new_data = NULL
)
```

```{r}
data_processed |> plot_spectra()
```


### SNV

```{r}
rec_snv <- rec |>
  step_log(all_outcomes(), base = 10) |>
  step_resample(grid = RESAMPLING_GRID) |>
  step_snv()
```

```{r}
rec_prep <- prep(rec_snv, training = data, verbose = TRUE)

data_processed <- bake(
  rec_prep,
  new_data = NULL
)
```

```{r}
data_processed |> plot_spectra()
```

### Savitsky-Golay 

```{r}
rec_sg <- rec |>
  step_log(all_outcomes(), base = 10) |>
  step_resample(grid = RESAMPLING_GRID) |> 
  step_snv() |> 
  step_sg(w = SG_W, p = SG_P, m = SG_M)
```

```{r}
rec_prep <- prep(rec_sg, training = data, verbose = TRUE)

data_processed <- bake(
  rec_prep,
  new_data = NULL
)
```

```{r}
data_processed |> plot_spectra()
```

## All steps together

```{r}
rec <- recipe(data) |>
  update_role(all_of(TARGET),  new_role = "outcome") |>
  update_role(all_of(spc_cols), new_role = "predictor") |>
  update_role(all_of(meta_cols), new_role = "metadata") |> 
  step_log(all_outcomes(), base = 10) |>
  step_resample(grid = RESAMPLING_GRID) |> 
  step_snv() |> 
  step_sg(w = SG_W, p = SG_P, m = SG_M)
```


```{r}
rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = data, verbose = TRUE)

data_processed <- bake(
  rec_prep,
  new_data = NULL
)
```

```{r}
data_processed |> plot_spectra()
```
